classes.name: Worker
classes.description: Represents a web or service worker, providing methods for evaluation, event handling, and lifecycle management.

methods.name: fromNullable
methods.description: Returns a Worker instance from a channel object or null if undefined.

methods.description: Evaluates a function or expression in the worker context.

methods.name: evaluateHandle
methods.description: Returns a handle to the result of evaluating a function or expression in the worker context.
